overall_status: MATCH: the ActionNameVars local-entry judgment chain (HighVariable::hasName at variable.cc:718-747, Funcdata::linkSymbol at funcdata_varnode.cc:1156-1186 with queryProperties/handleSymbolConflict/addSymbol, and the coreaction.cc:2988-2997 buildDefaultName+renameSymbol loop) byte-matches the locked 12.0.4 oracle on all six local shapes of the PRINTC-UNLINKED-REF-0001 family. Every nameable high (explicit register local -> lVar1, illegal register input -> in_SREG1, address-tied stack local in the local window -> lStack_b8, input whose storage already carries a category-0 function_parameter symbol -> attach with no new symbol) DOES get its ScopeLocal symbol through the Rugra chain, and every high the oracle refuses to name (implied Unique-space temporary, unaffected legal spacebase input) gets none on either side. This locks the diagnosis that the E2E 'unlinked local' backfill names (glob_url uVar_9100/uVar_1000004a Unique-space temps, RSP-copy uVar20, cast-shadow widths, and the piVar1 print-side rewrite of the already-symbolized uVar1) are NOT a varmap/variable symbol-coverage defect: those highs fail the same hasName gate in the oracle. Residuals routed elsewhere (see docs/TODO_BOARD.md PRINTC-UNLINKED-REF-0001): printc's get_varnode_display_name_inner fallback names implied/non-nameable varnodes and prettyprint's backfill_missing_locals injects their declarations (printc/prettyprint lease); ScopeLocal::register_names is a hardcoded 25-entry GPR table installed by ActionRestructureVarnode instead of the SLEIGH register catalog (golden in_XMM0_Qa vs in_register_00000110, coreaction/varmap wiring); Rugra's FuncProto has no ProtoStoreSymbol equivalent so formal parameters never pre-enter ScopeLocal and unaffected inputs symbolize as in_XXX (funcdata/fspec lease).
architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5 (spacebase over ram, pointer register 0x0 size 8, negative growth), join=6, iop=7; register catalog SREG1@0x100/8, SREG2@0x108/4
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, one stack localrange [0xffffffffffffff00, 0xffffffffffffffff] decoded through the production ProtoModel XML path

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of the ActionNameVars judgment chain per candidate: high->hasName() (the coreaction.cc:2961-2962 gate; for single-instance highs the name-representative check at cc:2959-2960 is trivially satisfied), then data.linkSymbol(vn) (cc:2963), then for a linked name-undefined symbol the cc:2988-2997 loop: buildDefaultName(sym, base=1, vn) + renameSymbol. No Action tree, no C emission
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Ghidra Funcdata built through the production ctor (funcdata.cc:34-96: ScopeLocal localmap + symbol-backed prototype store + resetLocalWindow against the decoded model). Each candidate Varnode is created with fd.newVarnode(size, addr, long), then carries its case flag set (insert always; implied / input / directwrite+spacebase+unaffected / addrtied per case) and fd.setHighLevel() assigns the HighVariable. The Rust comparand mirrors the same post-restructure state: a ScopeLocal installed into fd.scope with the same local window, negative growth, and register catalog, a vbank Varnode with the same flags and type, and set_high_level assigning the high
analysis_options.observation: Per case: the gate verdicts (hasName, linked) and the complete ScopeLocal contents after the naming loop - every symbol's name, storage space, offset, size, category, dynamic flag, and first-use point - printed in canonical (space-name, offset, size, name) order with multi-entry symbols deduplicated to their first whole map, followed by the dynamic-entry list
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, list, or membership normalization; symbol rows are re-sorted by the canonical key on both sides because the underlying storage (Ghidra per-space EntryMap lists vs Rugra Vec) orders differently while the set membership is the compared observable

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: explicit_register_local: register 0x0 size 8, insert only, type long - the strlen-result shape (glob_url piVar1's underlying merged high); linked and named lVar1 through the default-local branch with the shared base counter

implied_unique_temp: unique 0x9100 size 8, insert+implied, type long - the malloc-result temporary behind the backfilled uVar_9100 name; variable.cc:729-733 refuses the name, the scope stays empty on both sides

spacebase_stack_pointer: register 0x0 size 8, insert+input+directwrite+spacebase+unaffected - the stack-pointer input behind the backfilled uVar20 family; variable.cc:743 refuses the name (legal unaffected input that is the spacebase), the scope stays empty

irregular_input: register 0x100 size 8, insert+input (illegal: no directwrite), type long - the in_XXX shape; linked and named in_SREG1 through the irregular-input branch (database.cc:2467-2474 via translate getRegisterName)

addrtied_stack_local: stack 0xffffffffffffff48 size 8, insert+addrtied, type long, inside the local window; linked with an unrestricted use (funcdata_varnode.cc:1175-1176) and named lStack_b8 through ScopeLocal::buildVariableName's Stack branch (varmap.cc:548-577)

formal_param_attach: a p0 function_parameter symbol (category 0) pre-created at register 0x100 with usepoint base-1, then an input high at the same storage; queryProperties finds the entry and handleSymbolConflict attaches the input - no new symbol is created and the parameter category survives (the no_category decl-walk exclusion invariant behind the golden signature carrying parameters)

observation_schema.format: Twelve fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus six case records (gate line plus zero or one symbol rows) covering the per-candidate verdicts and the resulting scope contents
observation_schema.state: per-symbol name, storage space, offset, size, category, dynamic flag, first-use point in canonical sort order

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-varmap-unlinked-locals-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from the locked commit into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt there before the fixture is linked; no live worktree archive is consumed
build.private_state_observer: Read-only ABI observation of the ScopeLocal symbol table through the production MapIterator/beginDynamic walks via #define private/protected public in the fixture translation unit only; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/varmap.rs and src/variable.rs overlaid live; the fixture links the freshly built librugra.rlib and native librugra_sleigh.a the same way the production runners do
